value.brief:
Commander. Shack15. HIGH OPSEC exposure identified across two vectors.

HIGH — Fitness activity. Nine distinct exercise routes publicly visible via Strava heatmap. Peak activity 0600 to 0700 and 1700 to 1800 daily. An adversary can predict personnel movement patterns and potential PT routes with high accuracy.

HIGH — Satellite imaging. Sentinel-1A pass in 5.4 hours at 11 degrees elevation. Fifteen imaging opportunities within the next 24 hours. Any outdoor activity or equipment movement will be commercially visible.

MINIMAL — No recurring military flight patterns detected on public ADS-B feeds.

Composite exposure score: 55 out of 100. Risk level: MEDIUM.

Recommended actions. One: direct all personnel to set Strava profiles to private immediately. Two: restrict outdoor activities during satellite pass windows. Three: implement a base-wide OPSEC review focusing on personal device usage and geotagging.

[Note: ADS-B traffic is synthetic for V1 — derived from the populated Units/Platforms ontology. To be replaced by Member A's real ADS-B Exchange capture when available.]
